response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile software engineer with a long track record, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on web, JavaScript/TypeScript, and DLang development rather than C++. His only substantial C++ exposure was nearly a decade ago at National Instruments, and there is no evidence of experience with IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols, or embedded/industrial automation systems required for this role.
strengths: Extensive multi-year software engineering experience across many domains (web, mobile, embedded)
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems experience (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Sociomantic
Strong technical communication skills, mentoring, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (2014-2015), not the primary language in any recent role
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards experience
No exposure to MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850/104), or IoT/automation platforms
